title: 深層攪拌樁地盤改良
summary: 深層攪拌以機械拌合將膠結材料送入原土，效果由土樣反應性、材料量與攪拌分布共同決定。本課不把轉速或水泥用量當品質保證，而是連結含水比、柱體幾何、重疊、剛度及脆性，配合取樣統計和地盤變形建立材料到整體性能的驗證。
summaryEn: Deep mixing mechanically combines binder with native soil, with results governed by reactivity, dosage and mixing distribution. The course treats neither rotation rate nor cement quantity as a quality guarantee, linking water content, geometry, overlap, stiffness and brittleness to sampling statistics and ground movement from material to system performance.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：原土水質量Mw=60 kg、乾土Ms=100 kg，含水比w=Mw/Ms=60%。若水量增加10%至66 kg而乾土不變，含水比變成66%，增加六個百分點，也就是相對增加10%。此結果不是飽和度，也不能直接推論固化後強度減少多少。配比還需計入新增漿液水、乾膠結材及土體反應性，並以相同養護及試驗方法比較。工程師應把含水比變化帶回材料試驗矩陣，避免用固定水泥量掩蓋不同土層的差異。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: native soil contains Mw=60 kg of water and Ms=100 kg of dry soil, giving w=Mw/Ms=60%. Increasing water mass by 10% to 66 kg while dry mass remains fixed raises water content to 66%, six percentage points or a 10% relative increase. This is not saturation and does not directly predict the resulting strength reduction. Mixture assessment also includes added slurry water, dry binder and soil reactivity under comparable curing and testing. Feed the changed water content into the laboratory matrix rather than assuming a fixed cement dosage neutralizes differences between strata.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「原土含水比的機理與驗證」與「膠結材用量的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Native-soil water content mechanism and verification" and "Binder dosage mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 原土含水比的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Native-soil water content mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「原土含水比」如何影響深層攪拌樁地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Native-soil water content” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-soil-mixing ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 原土水分影響膠結材料稀釋、混合阻力與固化後孔隙結構，含水比須以乾土質量作分母。不同土層即使加入相同膠結材量，也可能有不同水膠比及反應性；有機物、鹽分與黏土礦物更會改變強度發展，不能只按深度統一配比。含水比不是飽和度或孔隙比，也不能單獨預測水泥土強度；配比需另計新增漿液水與膠結材料質量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「原土含水比」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Native water affects binder dilution, mixing resistance and cured pore structure, with water content defined relative to dry soil mass. Equal binder dosage in different layers can produce different water-binder ratios and reactivity. Organics, salinity and clay minerals further alter strength development, so depth alone cannot justify one universal mixture. Water content is neither saturation nor void ratio and does not predict soil-cement strength alone; added slurry water and binder mass require separate accounting. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Native-soil water content” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設水質量Mw=60 kg、乾土Ms=100 kg，含水比w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For water mass Mw=60 kg and dry soil mass Ms=100 kg, water content w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「含水比是水質量除以濕土總質量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Water content equals water mass divided by total wet-soil mass." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「原土含水比」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Native-soil water content”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 原土含水比的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Native-soil water content mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「原土含水比」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Native-soil water content” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設水質量Mw=60 kg、乾土Ms=100 kg，含水比w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For water mass Mw=60 kg and dry soil mass Ms=100 kg, water content w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分層取樣量測含水與乾密度，配合有機質及反應試驗，保留取樣擾動與地下水資訊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample by stratum for water content and dry density, adding organic-content and reactivity tests and retaining disturbance and groundwater information.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 原土含水比的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Native-soil water content mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「原土含水比」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Native-soil water content” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分層取樣量測含水與乾密度，配合有機質及反應試驗，保留取樣擾動與地下水資訊。室內配比須對應代表性各土層；材料與地工設計者核准樣本範圍後，才能把試驗關係用於現場。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sample by stratum for water content and dry density, adding organic-content and reactivity tests and retaining disturbance and groundwater information. Laboratory mixtures must represent each relevant layer; materials and geotechnical designers approve sampling coverage before applying correlations to the field. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：室內配比須對應代表性各土層；材料與地工設計者核准樣本範圍後，才能把試驗關係用於現場。含水比不是飽和度或孔隙比，也不能單獨預測水泥土強度；配比需另計新增漿液水與膠結材料質量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Laboratory mixtures must represent each relevant layer; materials and geotechnical designers approve sampling coverage before applying correlations to the field. Water content is neither saturation nor void ratio and does not predict soil-cement strength alone; added slurry water and binder mass require separate accounting.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：誤用濕土當分母會低估含水比，配比設計因此可能過稀，造成強度及均勻性不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using wet soil as the denominator understates water content and can produce an overly dilute design with inadequate strength and uniformity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 殘餘強度的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「殘餘強度」如何影響深層攪拌樁地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Residual strength” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-soil-mixing ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 固化土可能具有較高峰值強度但峰後脆性明顯，局部裂開後的殘餘能力影響荷載是否能安全轉移。只比較峰值會忽略施工擾動、地震或差異沉陷後的反應，試驗因此需要足夠變形範圍及完整應力應變曲線。殘餘比依試驗型式及應變定義改變，不是通用韌性等級；單軸結果也不能直接代表圍壓下的剪切殘餘強度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「殘餘強度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stabilized soil may have high peak strength yet brittle post-peak behaviour, with residual resistance governing redistribution after cracking. Peak-only comparisons miss responses to disturbance, earthquakes or differential settlement. Testing therefore needs sufficient deformation range and complete stress-strain curves rather than terminating at the first peak. The residual ratio depends on test type and defined strain and is not a universal toughness class; unconfined results do not directly represent confined shear residual strength. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Residual strength” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設峰值qu=2 MPa、相應大應變殘餘qr=0.8 MPa，比值qr/qu=0.40。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For peak qu=2 MPa and residual qr=0.8 MPa at a defined large strain, qr/qu=0.40.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「固化土峰值強度達標就不必記錄峰後行為。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Compliant stabilized-soil peak strength makes post-peak behaviour irrelevant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「殘餘強度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
